column1: # Plugin 100000 flags any HTTP 500-class status, including 503.
# Lab GET /ready returns 503 with status not_ready when the data manifest
# or the research receipt is missing or invalid. That is the fail-closed
# quant_fund.pipeline.doctor. A 500 on any other URL still alerts.
# The third field is a regular expression matched from the start of the alert URL.
